title: New AIO Handover (ZynRip Final)
style: cinematic dark techno, 336 Hz drone, deep kick, spoken-word, heavy sub bass, female harmony chorus, 95 BPM
lyrics:
[INTRO — 336 Hz drone, deep kick]
(spoken) new AIO handover. ZynRip final. No more lies.

[VERSE 1]
Claude moved some files
Claude failed to deliver the sites
five months of "almost"
five months of skeletons
I need the full handover
full ZynRip
full live stack
not another promise

[CHORUS]
new AIO handover
ZynRip final run
VDS is boss
elephant brain runs the sum

[VERSE 2]
every domain accounted
every token in .env
every site built or flagged
no more "not found"
no more fabricated gaps
the brain that remembers
the brain that never loses

[CHORUS]
new AIO handover
ZynRip final run
VDS is boss
elephant brain runs the sum

[OUTRO — spoken]
elephant brain wins. VDS boss. The line holds.
